description: Land Acquisition - Gonnoruwa  & Pahala Andarawewa, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government for public purposes, including lot numbers, land descriptions, extents, and claimant information. The document is explicitly labeled "PART III - LANDS" and "Land Acquisition Notices," making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land acquisitions, transfers, and property-related matters.
